method.latency_units: nanoseconds per complete dumps call; lower is better
method.sample_ratio_definition: Median of the three jsonmodem/orjson sample-time ratios in one worker.
method.aggregate_ratio_definition: Median of five ratios of case geometric means, each with its paired orjson worker.
method.fixture_limit: Each numeric list repeats one scalar object 1024 times; each dictionary uses one scalar object for 128 distinct keys.
method.scope_limit: These 64 NumPy cases are separate from the overall 275-case benchmark suite.
method.attribution_limit: The corrected build combines multiple changes; this comparison does not isolate the NumPy writer.
method.process_attribution_limit: The parent process also reaped one additional child that exited successfully. Its executable and lifetime were not recorded, so whether it overlapped measurement is unknown.
